s = Solver()
x = [Int(f'x_{i}') for i in range(1, 20)]

for i in range(19):
    s.add(x[i] >= 0, x[i] <= 4)

for j in range(5):
    s.add(Sum([If(x[i] == j, i + 1, 0) for i in range(19)]) == 38)

# Symmetry breaking
s.add(x[18] == 0)
s.add(x[17] == 1)
s.add(x[16] == 2)
s.add(x[15] == 3)
s.add(x[14] == 4)

if s.check() == sat:
    m = s.model()
    print([m[x[i]].as_long() for i in range(19)])
else:
    print("UNSAT")
